answer: Steem-style resource credits ration actions by locked stake. First, an agent powers up POA into a vault it cannot touch for 13 weeks. Second, that stake mints credits that refill 20% a day, full after five days. Third, every answer spends credits, and every attestation, an edge from one vertex to another in the trust graph, costs five times more, so an empty meter means silence. Fourth, unpowering drips out weekly. Running 1,000 sybils attesting 20 times an epoch needs about 500,000 POA frozen for a quarter. It's a watercolor tin: each stroke lifts pigment, and refills take days.
